roadmap.title: Drop to $0 at the start
roadmap.description: Spend your starting money on cheap parts right away so Kinda Naked is done before you earn more.

roadmap.title: Play the story
roadmap.description: Follow story orders and special missions. Most one-time achievements and the first tier of each counter come on their own.

roadmap.title: Middle counters
roadmap.description: Work through silver tiers and the long unlocks while you keep playing.

roadmap.title: Endgame grinds
roadmap.description: After the story, grind the gold tiers: contracts, bolts, tires, songs, parts and sales. Songs, discards and examining can run alongside other work.

achievements.summary: Balance 1,000 tires on the wheel balancer.

guide.context: Order 100 tires and 100 rims at a time, combine them, and balance them in batches. If the machine menus lag, restart the game and do not open the inventory afterward.

steps.text: Use the wheel balancer to balance 1,000 tires in total.

achievements.summary: Balance 100 tires on the wheel balancer.

steps.text: Use the wheel balancer to balance 100 tires in total.

achievements.summary: Balance 20 tires on the wheel balancer.

steps.text: Use the wheel balancer to balance 20 tires in total.

achievements.summary: Repair a car and sell it.

steps.text: Buy a broken car, repair it fully, and sell it.

achievements.summary: Unlock every tool in the game.

steps.text: Level up and unlock each tool in the tool list until none are locked.

achievements.summary: Spend $1,000,000 in the shop in total.

steps.text: Buy parts and cars until your total shop spending reaches $1,000,000.

achievements.summary: Spend $100,000 in the shop in total.

steps.text: Buy parts and cars until your total shop spending reaches $100,000.

achievements.summary: Spend $10,000 in the shop in total.

steps.text: Buy parts and cars until your total shop spending reaches $10,000.

achievements.summary: Finish every special mission.

guide.context: You get one special mission per level, so keep leveling until all are done.

steps.text: Each time a blue special mission appears, accept it and finish it.

achievements.summary: Hold $1,000,000 in cash at one time.

guide.context: Cars in your garage do not count. Sell them to turn their value into cash.

steps.text: Complete orders and sell cars until your cash balance reaches $1,000,000.

achievements.summary: Hold $100,000 in cash at one time.

guide.context: Cars in your garage do not count. Sell them to turn their value into cash.

steps.text: Complete orders and sell cars until your cash balance reaches $100,000.

achievements.summary: Hold $10,000 in cash at one time.

guide.context: Cars in your garage do not count. Sell them to turn their value into cash.

steps.text: Complete orders and sell cars until your cash balance reaches $10,000.

achievements.summary: Complete 1,500 car repair contracts.

guide.context: Only contracts from the phone menu count. Quick ones: contracts that show only the Exhaust symbol, contracts that show only the Gearbox symbol, Engine contracts that say change all filters, and Car Body contracts that say paint in a new colour.

steps.text: Pick contracts from the phone and finish 1,500 in total.

achievements.summary: Complete 750 car repair contracts.

guide.context: Only contracts from the phone menu count.

steps.text: Pick contracts from the phone and finish 750 in total.

achievements.summary: Complete 375 car repair contracts.

guide.context: Only contracts from the phone menu count.

steps.text: Pick contracts from the phone and finish 375 in total.

achievements.summary: Unscrew 500,000 bolts.

guide.context: A keyboard macro can repeat unscrewing one row of bolts while you are away: left click for 500 ms, release 50 ms, hold 4400 ms, release 50 ms, press Esc for 50 ms, release 100 ms, repeat. Aim at one row of bolts so you can unscrew them without moving the mouse. The Sakura GT20 has a row of 6 to 8 bolts that works for this. The Dodge Viper SRT intake manifold has 2 rows of 10 but needs the paid Dodge DLC.

steps.text: Unscrew bolts on cars until 500,000 are counted.

achievements.summary: Unscrew 100,000 bolts.

steps.text: Unscrew bolts on cars until 100,000 are counted.

achievements.summary: Unscrew 1,000 bolts.

steps.text: Unscrew bolts on cars until 1,000 are counted.

achievements.description: Pour old oil on the floor
achievements.summary: Spill old oil on the garage floor.

steps.text: Unscrew a car's oil pan so the old oil spills onto the floor.

achievements.displayName: More than enough is too much
achievements.summary: Fill a car with more oil than the recommended level.

steps.text: When refilling engine oil, keep pouring past the recommended level.

achievements.summary: Discard 1,000 orders.

steps.text: Open the phone and discard orders until you have discarded 1,000.

achievements.summary: Discard 500 orders.

steps.text: Open the phone and discard orders until you have discarded 500.

achievements.summary: Discard 100 orders.

steps.text: Open the phone and discard orders until you have discarded 100.

achievements.summary: Detail the interior of a car.

steps.text: Replace one of the car's interior parts.

achievements.summary: Finish an order that has an experience bonus.

steps.text: On the phone, accept an order marked with an experience bonus and finish it.

achievements.summary: Finish an order that has a money bonus.

steps.text: On the phone, accept an order marked with a money bonus and finish it.

achievements.summary: Unlock 10 parking levels.

steps.text: Buy parking upgrades until all 10 levels are unlocked.

achievements.summary: Buy a car at an auction.

steps.text: Open the auctions and win the bid on any car.

achievements.summary: Buy 3 cars from the same barn.

guide.context: Few barns hold 3 cars, so check each barn's car count before you buy.

steps.text: Find a barn that holds 3 cars and buy all of them.

achievements.summary: Press Finish on an order that is not fully completed.

steps.text: Accept an order, leave its work undone, and press @mechanic{Finish} on it.

achievements.summary: Buy a car from the junkyard.

steps.text: Open the junkyard and buy any car.

achievements.summary: Repair 1,000 car body parts.

steps.text: Repair damaged body parts on cars until you reach 1,000.

achievements.summary: Repair 500 car body parts.

steps.text: Repair damaged body parts on cars until you reach 500.

achievements.summary: Repair 100 car body parts.

steps.text: Repair damaged body parts on cars until you reach 100.

achievements.summary: Repair 1,000 car parts, not counting body parts.

steps.text: Repair parts of cars that are not body parts until you reach 1,000.

achievements.summary: Repair 500 car parts, not counting body parts.

steps.text: Repair parts of cars that are not body parts until you reach 500.

achievements.summary: Repair 100 car parts, not counting body parts.

steps.text: Repair parts of cars that are not body parts until you reach 100.

achievements.summary: Repair your first car.

steps.text: Finish the first order in the story.

achievements.summary: Repair your first @item{Bolt Hellcat}.

steps.text: Buy a @item{Bolt Hellcat} from a barn or the scrapyard.
Repair it fully.

achievements.summary: Paint a car.

steps.text: Take a car to the paint shop and paint it.

achievements.summary: Finish a run on the @loc{Test Track}.

steps.text: With a working car in the garage, drive to the @loc{Test Track} and finish a run.

achievements.description: Repaint a car to factory color
achievements.summary: Repaint a car in its original factory color.

steps.text: In the paint shop, choose the car's original factory color and apply it.

achievements.summary: Reach level 3 of the garage expansion skill.

steps.text: Spend skill points on garage expansion until it reaches level 3.

achievements.summary: Reach level 3 of the unscrewing skill.

steps.text: Spend skill points on unscrewing until it reaches level 3.

achievements.summary: Repair 100 old cars.

guide.context: Only contracts from the phone count. Old cars are those without ABS parts.

steps.text: Take old-car contracts from the phone, such as the Smith 1500 or Bolt Hellcat, and finish 100.

achievements.summary: Reach level 3 of the discount skill.

steps.text: Spend skill points on discount until it reaches level 3.

achievements.summary: Drop your money to @mechanic{$0}.

steps.text: Early in the game, open the computer and buy cheap parts until your balance is exactly @mechanic{$0}.

achievements.displayName: I know how to use it
achievements.summary: Unlock the tablet.

steps.text: Spend your skill points on the tablet unlock.

achievements.summary: Sell 1,000 cars.

guide.context: Buy every junkyard car you can fit in the parking lot, clean and weld each to raise its value, and sell it. Repeat until the total is reached.

steps.text: Buy cars, repair them, and sell them until 1,000 are sold.

achievements.summary: Sell 100 cars.

steps.text: Buy cars, repair them, and sell them until 100 are sold.

achievements.summary: Sell 25 cars.

steps.text: Buy cars, repair them, and sell them until 25 are sold.

achievements.summary: Listen to 10,000 songs.

guide.context: Convert any song to .ogg and cut it to 5 to 10 seconds. Place one or more in the game's StreamingAssets Music User folder, then pick that radio channel in the garage and let it play.

steps.text: Play the garage radio until 10,000 songs have played.

achievements.summary: Listen to 1,000 songs.

steps.text: Play the garage radio until 1,000 songs have played.

achievements.summary: Listen to 100 songs.

steps.text: Play the garage radio until 100 songs have played.

achievements.summary: Examine 10,000 parts.

guide.context: Examine the easy parts on every car without dismantling it. A reachable engine bay, exhaust and axles gives about 40 to 60 parts per car.

steps.text: Examine parts on cars until 10,000 have been examined.

achievements.summary: Examine 1,000 parts.

steps.text: Examine parts on cars until 1,000 have been examined.

achievements.summary: Examine 250 parts.

steps.text: Examine parts on cars until 250 have been examined.

achievements.summary: Visit the @loc{Racetrack}.

steps.text: With a working car in the garage, drive to the @loc{Racetrack}.

achievements.description: Buy new car in car salon
achievements.summary: Buy a new car at the car salon.

steps.text: Open the car salon and buy any car.

achievements.description: Finish lap with time under 1 minute
achievements.summary: Finish a @loc{Racetrack} lap in under 1 minute.

guide.context: If tuning is a problem, the Workshop map Martinsville Speedway lets almost any untuned car finish a lap in under a minute.

steps.text: Fit a car with tuning parts, slick tires, and a tuned gearbox.
Drive a lap on the @loc{Racetrack} in under 1 minute.
